description: netcode-http's router on quic-zig's event loop, which serves HTTP/1.1, WebSocket and HTTP/3 from one loop: one loop per core, sharing the ports through SO_REUSEPORT. Routes decode their query and body from a typed spec; a WebSocket is a route too, on quic-zig's upgrade and framing. QUIC, TLS 1.3 and HTTP/3 are quic-zig's own, in Zig, with no C library.
